propositions: CLI reference syntax sections and options must be generated deterministically from runtime parser registries and committed help bytes, with --check validation proving byte-current parity
Manual regex-based command census (INTERCEPT_COMMANDS, ladder_intercepts) must be eliminated; all command enumeration must derive from canonical route registry
All CLI tests (help overview, argparse routing, exit-code contracts) must enumerate commands via registry policy sets rather than hand-maintained policy unions
A clean wheel without optional dependencies must render all approved help forms with exact committed bytes and produce no side effects from operation, config, store, or handler imports
Every lazy handler, parser selector, and capability-to-extra reference must resolve successfully without command execution under full-extra contract validation
Editorial preamble and rationale must be structurally separated, linted for valid top-level command spellings, and never override authoritative generated parser syntax
